meta.source: Blizzard Game Data journal-encounter + Wowhead tooltip API
meta.readMe: Ability text and damage magnitudes come from Wowhead's tooltip endpoint, which is the only source carrying tuned numbers for this tier -- Blizzard's /data/wow/spell/<id> returns 404 for these ids and the in-game journal text ships 'X' placeholders. A magnitude here is ONE difficulty's value and the endpoint does not say which; cross-check against measured damage taken in profiles/<spec>-<difficulty>.json before quoting it as a Mythic number.

encounter.name: The Coiled Altar
encounter.description: The spirit of Malacrass will not release his grip on Zul'jan so easily. At the Coiled Altar, the shaman commands the warrior to enact the final ritual to unleash Ula'tek on the Amani--for revenge, and to gain their promised reward.

notes.title: Overview
notes.bodyText:
A mutated Zul'jan unleashes his new power by [Coalescing Venom] within The Coiled Altar. He wields twin axes that [Sever] players and destroy Coalesced Venom.

Upon Zul'jan's defeat, Malacrass joins the fray. Malacrass haunts players with [Dreadmarch], creating Manifestations of Dread as it resolves. His casts of [Soul Sever] hurt players and destroy any Manifestations of Dread in its blast.

Upon defeat, Malacrass begins a ritual of [Soulbinding] to revive Zul'jan as his puppet, and claim what is rightfully his.

abilities.title: Fangs of the Coiled Altar
abilities.description:
Zul'jan channels the power of The Coiled Altar, inflicting 83341 Nature damage to all players and gaining 3 applications of Twinfang Toxin every 1 sec for 8 sec.

The mouths of The Coiled Altar overflow, spewing Noxious Ground beneath them that quickly swell and slowly subside over time.

abilities.title: Twinfang Toxin
abilities.description: Zul'jan's melee attacks consume applications of Twinfang Toxin, inflicting an additional 333363 Nature damage to his current target.

abilities.title: Noxious Ground
abilities.description: The poisonous ground inflicts 166682 Nature damage every 1 sec to players standing within.

abilities.title: Toxic Deluge
abilities.description: The crucible spews venom into the chamber, inflicting 833407 Nature damage to players within 4 yards of the impact locations, and creating Coalesced Venom.

abilities.title: Coalesced Venom
abilities.description:
A toxic globule that pulses with venom, inflicting 17710 Nature damage to all players every 2 sec. Triggers a Venom Rupture when destroyed.

Stepping on the globule attaches itself to the player, applying Volatile Venom.

abilities.title: Venom Rupture
abilities.description: The globule explodes, inflicting until canceled. This effect stacks.

abilities.title: Volatile Venom
abilities.description:
Ula'tek's venom reacts violently to the player, inflicting 87508 Nature damage every 1 sec to players within 5 yards for 5 sec.

Upon expiring, creates a Coalesced Venom.

abilities.title: Caustic Secretion
abilities.description: The cyst expels 2 Coalesced Venoms every 6 sec, inflicting 583385 Nature damage to players within 4 yards of each impact point.

abilities.title: Virulent Mutation
abilities.description:
A volatile globule that pulses with venom, inflicting 17710 Nature damage to all players every 1 sec. Violently explodes nearby globules, triggering 20 Venom Ruptures.

Stepping on the globule attaches itself to the player, applying Mutagenic Venom.

abilities.title: Mutagenic Venom
abilities.description:
A mutated venom that reacts violently to the player, inflicting 250022 Nature damage every 1 sec to players within 8 yards for 5 sec. Violently explodes nearby globules, triggering 20 Venom Ruptures.

Upon expiring, creates a Virulent Mutation.

abilities.title: Tainted Blood
abilities.description: The venom enters your bloodstream, increasing damage taken from Volatile Venom by 200% for 10 sec.

abilities.title: Guillotine
abilities.description:
Zul'jan throws his axe at a player, inflicting 5417143 Physical damage split evenly among players within 9 yards of the target and increasing their damage taken from Guillotine by 500% for 1.7 min. This effect ignores armor. The axe then swells with poison before erupting with a Widow's Kiss.

If Guillotine fails to hit at least 5 players, the axe instead inflicts an Execution.

abilities.title: Execution
abilities.description: Inflicts 1666814 Nature damage to all players.

abilities.title: Widow's Kiss
abilities.description: The Axe erupts in a violent plume that scatters a deadly toxin, inflicting 1250110 Nature to damage to players within 40 yards.

abilities.title: Widow's Touch
abilities.description: The nearby explosion inflicts 208352 Nature damage to players at least 40 yards away from the epicenter.

abilities.title: Guillotined
abilities.description: Increases damage taken from Guillotine by 500%.

abilities.title: Sever
abilities.description:
Zul'jan unleashes a mighty cleave at his current target, inflicting 3333627 Physical damage to players in a frontal cone and increasing their damage taken from Sever by 600% for 33 sec.

Destroys Coalesced Venoms and Virulent Mutations.

abilities.title: Venomfang
abilities.description: Zul'jan hurls a poison-coated axe between multiple players, inflicting 125011 Nature damage every 2 sec for 14 sec.

abilities.title: Axegrinder
abilities.description: Zul'jan hurls out axes that inflict 1000088 Physical damage to players within 4 yards of each impact point, knocking them away. The axes wander the arena for 3 min, inflicting 125011 Physical damage every 0.25 sec to players within 0 yards. This effect ignores armor.

abilities.title: Dreadmarch
abilities.description:
Malacrass possesses multiple players, causing them to absorb 568393 damage as they march towards the edge of the platform and jump to their death.

Upon removal, [multiple][2] Manifestations of Dread emerge from the possessed player.

abilities.title: Unnerving Fixation
abilities.description:
A Manifestation of Dread gazes upon a random player, moving toward them whenever the player isn't staring back.

If it reaches its target, it possesses them with Dreadmarch.

abilities.title: Despair
abilities.description: The Manifestation of Dread's terrifying presence overwhelms the player, inflicting 333363 Shadow damage and knocking them back.

abilities.title: Malevolent Resonance
abilities.description: When two Manifestations come into contact their shared anguish resonates violently, both inflicting 666725 Shadow damage to their fixated target every 1 sec for 5 sec.

abilities.title: Soul Sever
abilities.description:
Malacrass unleashes a blast of shadow energy at his current target, inflicting 1041758 Shadow damage to players in a frontal cone. Increases their damage taken from Soul Sever by 600% and inflicts 125011 Shadow damage every 2 sec for 45 sec. Players hit are afflicted with Gravebound.

Destroys Manifestations of Dread.

abilities.title: Gravebound
abilities.description:
The player's soul is fractured until their Soul Fragments are recovered. Stepping on a fragment reclaims part of their soul, inflicting 208352 Shadow damage.

Upon expiration, the player ceases to exist.

abilities.title: Eternal Nightfall
abilities.description:
Malacrass surrounds himself in a Veil of Twilight, preparing to unleash a devastating attack that will inflict 2500220 Shadow damage and an additional 416703 Shadow damage every 1 sec to all players. 

Twilight falls around the arena, applying additional stacks of Suffocating Darkness to players within 5 yards of each impact location.

This spell is interruptible if the shield is broken.

abilities.title: Veil of Twilight
abilities.description: Darkness surrounds Malacrass, absorbing 34828299 damage and applying Suffocating Darkness to all players every 2 sec.

abilities.title: Suffocating Darkness
abilities.description: Coats the player in shadows, absorbing 122915 healing. This effect stacks.

abilities.title: Spiritcackle
abilities.description: Malacrass calls upon spirits to manifest multiple Spiteful Soulcoilers to aid him in combat.

abilities.title: Wail of Terror
abilities.description: A terrifying scream is released, fearing all players for 5 sec.

abilities.title: Retaliatory Malice
abilities.description: The reawakened spirit holds a grudge against living creatures, releasing dark blasts of energy that inflict 250022 Shadow damage to random players every 3 sec.

abilities.title: Consumed by Resentment
abilities.description: Upon reaching 100 energy the Spiteful Soulcoiler is consumed by hatred, providing immunity to interrupt effects.

abilities.title: Spirit Shield
abilities.description:
A shield of ethereal energy that reduces damage taken by 99%. 

Being hit by Gloombomb weakens the shield.

abilities.title: Gloombomb
abilities.description:
Malacrass infuses players with shadow, marking them for 5 sec. Upon expiration they explode, inflicting 500044 Shadow damage to players within 15 yards. Players hit are afflicted with Gravebound.

On Mythic difficulty, Gloombomb removes one application of Spiteful Soulcoiler's Spirit Shield.

abilities.title: Gloombomb
abilities.description: Malacrass infuses players with shadow, marking them for 5 sec. Upon expiration, they explode, inflicting 500044 Shadow damage to players within 15 yards.  Players hit are also afflicted with Gravebound.

abilities.title: Dread Bolt
abilities.description: Malacrass shoots a bolt of shadow, inflicting 208451 Shadow damage to his primary target.

abilities.title: Dreadful Presence
abilities.description: Malacrass radiates a terrifying aura, inflicting 192517 Shadow damage every 2 sec to all players.

abilities.title: Soulbinding
abilities.description:
Malacrass begins a ritual to bind his soul to Zul'jan, applying Ghastly Regeneration to him. Any healing Zul'jan receives is duplicated to Malacrass.

Fragments of Malacrass rupture from Zul'jan's body while the ritual holds, and attempt to return to their new host.

abilities.title: Ghastly Regeneration
abilities.description:
Necrotic energies overwhelm Zul'jan, healing 2% of his maximum health every 1 sec for 35 sec.

The volatile process takes a toll on his body, increasing his damage taken by 100%

abilities.title: Spirit Erasure
abilities.description: The fragment is violently erased from existence when stepped on, inflicting 166682 Shadow damage to all players. It writhes in agony, causing all players to take 20% increased damage from Spirit Erasure for 2 sec. This effect stacks.

abilities.title: Reclaim Essence
abilities.description: The fragment reaches Zul'jan, healing him for 10% of his maximum health.

abilities.title: Deathguard
abilities.description: Malacrass surrounds himself with baleful energies, absorbing any stunned Manifestations of Dread and reducing his damage taken by 99%.

abilities.title: Soulbound
abilities.description: Malacrass links his soul with Zul'jan, causing the other to berserk if one is defeated, increasing their attack speed and damage done by 100%.

abilities.title: Soulbound
abilities.description: 100% of damage taken by Zul'jan or Malacrass is additionally dealt to the other.

abilities.title: Defilement of the Coiled Altar
abilities.description:
Zul'jan defiles The Coiled Altar, applying a barrier that absorbs the next (85259 * 8) healing to all players and gaining 3 applications of Corrupted Toxin every 1 sec for 8 sec.

The mouths of The Coiled Altar overflow, spewing Defiled Ground beneath them that quickly swell and slowly subside over time.

abilities.title: Corrupted Toxin
abilities.description: Zul'jan's melee attacks consume applications of Corrupted Toxin, inflicting 41670 Shadow damage every 1 sec for 6 sec. This effect stacks.

abilities.title: Defiled Ground
abilities.description: The corrupted ground causes players standing within to absorb 85259 healing every 1 sec.

abilities.title: Grim Guillotine
abilities.description:
Zul'jan throws his axe at a player, inflicting 5417143 Shadow damage split evenly among players within 9 yards of the target2 min and causing them to absorb the next (85259 * 6) healing. The axe then swells with necrotic energies before erupting with a Death's Embrace.

If Grim Guillotine fails to hit at least 5 players, the axe instead inflicts a Grim Execution.

abilities.title: Grim Execution
abilities.description: Inflicts 1666814 Shadow damage to all players.

abilities.title: Death's Embrace
abilities.description: The Axe erupts in a violent torrent of screaming souls, inflicting 1250110 Shadow damage to players within 40 yards.

abilities.title: Death's Whisper
abilities.description: The nearby explosion inflicts 208352 Shadow damage to players at least 40 yards away from the epicenter.

abilities.title: Guillotined
abilities.description: Increases damage taken from Grim Guillotine by 500%.

abilities.title: Blighted Sever
abilities.description:
Zul'jan unleashes a devastating cleave at his current target, inflicting 833407 Shadow damage to players in a frontal cone. Increases their damage taken from Blighted Sever by 600% for 45 sec and afflicts them with Gravebound.

[Destroys Coalesced Venoms, Virulent Mutations, and Manifestations of Dread.][Destroys Coalesced Venoms and Manifestations of Dread.]
